steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Divide. Each cost is divided by its units, and a zero unit count with cost is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 unit count of zero carries cost

findings.title: Unit count of zero carries cost
findings.fix: Correct the count or move the cost

findings.title: Cost category with no allocation basis

outcome.notChecked: Whether the allocation basis is fair.

pros: Checks a cost category with no allocation basis, a unit count of zero with cost, and a month with a missing cost.
cons: Not checked: Whether the allocation basis is fair.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ops-unit-cost skill on the records for this review.
